ائتكلوا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَكَلُوا (iʔtakalū) /iʔ.ta.ka.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# اِئْتَكِلُوا (iʔtakilū) /iʔ.ta.ki.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
